findings.title: Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
findings.remediation: Set a restrictive CSP such as: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'

findings.title: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
findings.evidence: Target responded over HTTP; HSTS is only honored over HTTPS.
findings.remediation: Serve production traffic exclusively over HTTPS and set: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains

findings.title: Clickjacking Protection (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
findings.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN) and CSP frame-ancestors 'none'.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy
findings.remediation: Disable unused browser APIs: Permissions-Policy: geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=()

findings.title: Cross-Origin Isolation (COOP / CORP)
findings.evidence: Neither Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy nor Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy is set.
findings.remediation: Add Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin and Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin.

findings.title: Cookie 'sessionid' HttpOnly Flag
findings.evidence: Cookie 'sessionid' is missing the HttpOnly attribute.
findings.remediation: Add 'HttpOnly' to Set-Cookie for 'sessionid' to block JavaScript access.

findings.title: Cookie 'sessionid' Secure Flag
findings.owasp_ref: OWASP A02:2021 - Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Data
findings.evidence: Cookie 'sessionid' is missing the Secure attribute.
findings.remediation: Add 'Secure' to Set-Cookie for 'sessionid' and enforce HTTPS.

findings.title: Cookie 'sessionid' SameSite Attribute
findings.evidence: Cookie 'sessionid' is missing the SameSite attribute.
findings.remediation: Set SameSite=Strict or SameSite=Lax on cookie 'sessionid'.

findings.title: Server & Technology Version Disclosure
findings.evidence: Response headers expose technology details: Server: Apache/2.4.49 (Demo), x-powered-by: PHP/7.4.3
findings.remediation: Strip X-Powered-By / X-AspNet-Version headers and minimize Server banner version tokens.

findings.title: Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS)
findings.evidence: Arbitrary Origin 'https://auditor-cors-check.example' is reflected in Access-Control-Allow-Origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
findings.remediation: Validate Origin against a strict static allowlist and never combine untrusted reflection with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
